When the sure event happens.
No one can say it is a lie.
It brings some people low and lifts some people high.
When the earth is shaken with a big shake.
And the mountains are crushed and crumble.
And become scattered dust.
And you will be three groups.
The people of the right. How wonderful are the people of the right!
The people of the left. How terrible are the people of the left!
And the ones who raced ahead in goodness, the first ones.
They are the closest to Allah.
They are in gardens of joy.
Many from the early people.
And a few from the later people.
On rich couches.
They rest on them, facing each other.
Boys who never grow old will go around serving them.
With cups, jugs and glasses of drink from a flowing spring.
It does not give them a headache or make them dizzy.
And fruits of their choice.
And meat of birds, whatever they want.
And beautiful companions.
Like pearls kept safe.
As a reward for what they used to do.
There they will not hear useless talk or bad words.
Only the greeting: Peace, peace.
And the people of the right. How wonderful are the people of the right!
In gardens full of fruit trees.
And sweet-smelling plants.
And shade that spreads out.
And water that keeps pouring.
And lots of fruit.
It never runs out and is never kept from them.
And high, soft beds.
We made them in a special way.
And made them young and pure.
Gentle and never growing old.
For the people of the right.
Many from the early people.
And many from the later people.
And the people of the left. How terrible are the people of the left!
In a burning wind and boiling water.
And in the shadow of thick black smoke.
It is not cool and not nice.
Before this they lived an easy life.
And they kept on doing big wrong things.
And they used to say: When we are dead and become dust and bones, will we really be raised up?
And our fathers long ago too?
Say: Yes, the first and the last.
Will all be gathered at the time of a Day that is known.
Then you, who are lost and said it was a lie.
Will eat from the tree called Zaqqum, a bitter tree.
And fill your bellies with it.
And drink boiling water on top of it.
Drinking like thirsty camels.
That is their welcome on the Day of Payment.
We made you. If only you would believe!
Have you thought about what you pour out?
Do you make it into a person, or are We the Maker?
We have set death among you, and We cannot be beaten.
We can change you for people like you and make you into what you do not know.
You know the first making. If only you would remember!
Have you thought about what you plant?
Do you make it grow, or are We the One who grows it?
If We wanted, We could turn it into broken bits, and then you would be sad.
You would say: We are in debt!
No, we are kept from it.
Have you thought about the water you drink?
Did you send it down from the clouds, or did We?
If We wanted, We could make it salty. Will you not say thank you?
Have you thought about the fire you light?
Did you make its tree grow, or did We?
We made it a reminder and a help for people who travel.
So praise the name of your great Lord.
I swear by where the stars set.
It is a very big promise, if you only knew.
This is a noble Quran.
In a well-kept Book.
Only the clean touch it.
It is sent down from the Lord of all.
Is it this message that you take lightly?
And you make your living by saying it is a lie?
So when the soul reaches the throat.
And you are watching.
We are nearer to him than you are, but you do not see.
If you are not going to be asked about what you did.
Then bring it back, if you are telling the truth.
But if he is one of those brought close to Allah.
Then he has happiness, sweet smells and a Garden of joy.
And if he is one of the people of the right.
Then: Peace be with you, from the people of the right.
But if he is one who said it was a lie and was lost.
Then he gets a welcome of boiling water.
And burning in Hell.
This is the certain truth.
So praise the name of your Lord, the Great.
